将拖拉机外观替换为熊蜂纹理，需要AT （Alternative Textures） 前置，使用AT中的剪刀道具更换新纹理。

Replaces the tractor's appearance with bumblebee textures. Requires AT (Alternative Textures) as a prerequisite. Use the scissors tool in AT to apply the new look.
Recommended to be used with the tractor garage from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45322]LBXLW'S A Spring in Bloom Farm Buildings (CP) and (AT)[/url].
